# algolia_collection (Data Source)

Read-only lookup of an Algolia Collection by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_index" "example" {
  name                = "products"
  deletion_protection = false
}

resource "algolia_collection" "example" {
  name       = "Summer Deals"
  index_name = algolia_index.example.name

  records = ["sku-1001", "sku-1002"]

  deletion_protection = false
}

data "algolia_collection" "example" {
  id = algolia_collection.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the collection.

### Read-Only

- `conditions` (Block, Read-only) Filter rules selecting records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditions))
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the collection was created.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the collection.
- `index_name` (String) Name of the index the collection belongs to.
- `name` (String) Display name of the collection.
- `records` (List of String) objectIDs currently in the collection.
- `status` (String) Commit status reported by the API.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the collection was last updated.

<a id="nestedblock--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Read-Only:

- `facet_filter` (Block List) A single AND clause of OR-ed filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditions--facet_filter))
- `numeric_filter` (Block List) A single AND clause of OR-ed filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditions--numeric_filter))

<a id="nestedblock--conditions--facet_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.facet_filter`

Read-Only:

- `filters` (List of String) OR-ed filter expressions.
